# Test models

Tiny models for the converter and upload tests, made for this repo (no third-party content):
`box.obj` + `box.mtl` + `checker.png` (a 20 mm textured cube), `box-obj.zip` (the same, zipped in a folder),
`tetra.stl` (ASCII, millimetres, Z up, normals written as 0 0 0 like many STL exporters), `cube.gltf` + `cube.bin` +
`checker.png` (a 10 cm textured cube with an external buffer).
